pages.text: Tinkers' Construct and Construct's Armory are optional. The mod has no own tools or armor. Its materials work in them instead.$(br2)Endorium. Tool: Ender Pocket (drops and XP go to your inventory, then to your ender chest). Armor: Blink.$(br)Tungsten. Tool: Grounding (a hit target cannot teleport for 10 s). Armor: Anchored.

Infused ingot. Tool: Siphon (drains chunk entropy for mining speed and repair). Armor: Absorb (entropy becomes absorption hearts).$(br)Dragon scales. Bow string: Breath (an arrow leaves a small dragon breath cloud). Armor: Void rescue.$(br2)With Ender Storage and an Ender Pouch, the Ender Pocket uses the pouch chest.
